author: B

components.title: Filter shipped orders
components.what: Extract all orders with status equal to shipped from the table.

components.title: Compute median of units
components.what: Sort the units values of shipped orders and calculate the median.

log.author: B
log.draft:
Shipped-order units: 6, 36, 34, 2, 20, 12, 15, 20, 34, 38.

Sorted: 2, 6, 12, 15, 20, 20, 34, 34, 36, 38.

There are 10 values, so the median is the average of the 5th and 6th values: (20 + 20) / 2 = 20.

FINAL: 20
